title: BillingPro
description: A multi-tenant billing and operations platform for GST-aware invoices, payments, inventory, purchase orders, and customer management. Includes role-based access, recurring invoices, PDF generation, and Razorpay integration.

title: DocuMind
description: An authenticated PDF workspace with structured OCR, per-page analysis, and document chat with source citations. Combines document extraction, vector search, and reranking to ground answers in selected PDFs.

title: Traceable Impact
description: A reporting platform for nonprofits that turns inconsistent program files into source-linked metrics. Features human-reviewed column mappings and duplicate matches, privacy safeguards, audit trails, and PDF or HTML reports.

title: Human Digital Twin
description: A student wellness platform with an interactive 3D twin, daily observations, nine wellness dimensions, and personalized forecasts. Supports Random Forest models, what-if lifestyle simulations, and prediction-versus-actual tracking.

title: CrowdSense AI
description: A crowd monitoring platform using YOLOv8 for person detection and crowd counting. Includes occupancy monitoring, risk classification, historical analytics, video upload analysis, and PDF reports.

title: MGHSIS
description: A mass-gathering safety prototype combining wearable telemetry, CCTV crowd analytics, and gate events in a venue digital twin. Provides zone-level risk prediction, scenario simulation, and human-authorized intervention workflows.

title: AI Battery Fast Charging
description: A Soft Actor-Critic reinforcement learning agent for adaptive lithium-ion battery charging. Uses a simplified Single Particle Model with temperature, voltage, and aging penalties, plus a Streamlit simulation dashboard.

title: Trading Log — Web App
description: A browser-based trading journal with JWT authentication, trade management, profit/loss analytics, search, filters, and CSV export. Integrates Alpha Vantage market prices and converts the original desktop workflow into a responsive web app.

title: Trading Log — Desktop App
description: A Java Swing desktop application for recording and analyzing trades. Provides login authentication, trade management, market price integration, profit/loss analysis, reporting, and CSV export.
